summary: Adds the @elizaos/capacitor-action-journal package around 0077: bridge definitions, registerActionJournal(name) with a fail-closed browser fallback, nextStep(entry) (only a reserved entry may dispatch; applying or unknown outcomes reconcile) and isJournalEntry shape checks, with node tests. Applies after 0077 (disjoint added files in the same package directory).

contract.registerActionJournal: host-chosen Capacitor name; browsers reject with code unavailable
contract.nextStep: reserved -> dispatch; applying -> reconcile(since applyingAt); terminal unknown -> reconcile; other terminal -> settled
contract.isJournalEntry: refuses malformed scope, ids, hash, record, phase/status combinations and success without an attempt

verification.where: clean sparse clone of baseCommit with 0077 applied

isolation: Authored in a sparse --shared clone of vendor/eliza checked out at baseCommit under the session scratchpad and exported with scripts/export-eliza-patch.mjs; applied and tested only in a second clean sparse clone of baseCommit; never applied to vendor/eliza.
deployment: Not submitted upstream. Reference-only until Alpha consumes the module: Gradle must include ../.eliza/patched/plugins/plugin-native-action-journal/android as :eliza-action-journal (android/settings.gradle) and the app must depend on it (android/app/build.gradle); test/eliza-patch-preparation.test.mjs must stop pinning the applied set to 0038 only. Then re-export 0077 and 0078 at the pin with scripts/export-eliza-patch.mjs to applied <topic>-source.json manifests and make AlphaActionJournalPlugin extend ActionJournalPlugin with namespace action-journal:v1 and its existing result rules as the ResultPolicy.
